title: InferBeat: census of tail-latency signatures and interactive explorer by route/model/region
creator: Ava Kline
description: Goal: Provide a census of p95/p99 latency signatures and a lightweight interactive explorer that surfaces regressions per route, model, and region. Unlike existing coarse rollups, InferBeat will correlate percentile shifts with tokens/sec, batch sizes, and KV cache hit rates and provide one-click drilldowns to replay synthetic traffic for the implicated slices. Deliverables: (1) instrumentation changes to emit percentile slice counts and auxiliary signals (tokens/sec, batch, kv_hit) into the metric pipeline; (2) an ETL job to compute per-slice baseline windows and anomaly scores; (3) an interactive Explorer UI with matrix, heatmap, and sample-playback links per route/model/region; (4) alerting rules that tie percentile drift to a suggested rollback or canary check; (5) small load-playback harness that replays example traces for quick RCA.
acceptance_criteria: p95 and p99 metrics emitted for each request with slice tags: route, model, region, batch_profile
Explorer UI shows heatmap of current vs baseline percentiles and supports filtering by route/model/region
ETL computes a 14-day baseline per slice and exposes an anomaly_score; backend query latency for explorer panels < 1s for 95% of queries
Synthetic replay harness can reproduce a failing slice with configurable tokens/sec and KV cache settings in a staging region
An alert template created that recommends canary rollback if p99 increases by >25% and anomaly_score > 0.8
Documentation and runbook added for on-call to investigate percentile regressions using the explorer
tasks: Design metric schema: add 'slice_id', 'batch_profile', 'kv_cache_hit' tags to percentile emitter
Implement emitter in serving runtime (instrumentation + low-overhead aggregator)
Create ETL: baseline calc, anomaly scoring, and storing slice profiles in telemetry DB
Build Explorer backend endpoints and aggregation queries (optimize for time-series rollups)
Implement frontend panels: heatmap matrix, slice detail, playback trigger
Integrate small playback harness in infra: dockerized harness job + paramized workload generator
Add alerting rules and a dashboard link in on-call rotation
Write docs: observability guide, dashboard walkthrough, and RCA playbook
notes_and_decisions: Decision: Use 14-day rolling baseline to balance sensitivity and noise for typical enterprise workloads
Trade-off: Emit aggregated percentile counters per-minute rather than per-request to limit cardinality and SLO cost
Design choice: Anomaly scoring uses weighted combination of relative change and sample-count-adjusted z-score
Rollout plan: Start with a subset of high-traffic routes (chat.generate, completion.text) in us-west-2, then expand
Storage: Use existing telemetry timeseries store for raw counts and a small Postgres table for slice baselines
Sampling: For low-volume slices, fallback to nearest-model-region aggregation to avoid noisy alerts
risks: High-cardinality explosion if we add too many slice tags — mitigate with controlled tag set and cardinality caps
Backend query latency under heavy explorer usage — precompute common rollups and cache top-100 slices
False positives for p99 on thin slices — use sample-count thresholds before alerting
Replaying some failures may be non-deterministic due to model nondeterminism and KV cache state
